objectives: Students read fundamental ethical texts—Platonic, Aristotelian, and Stoic—in order to understand how non-Abrahamic Mediterranean philosophies addressed ethical issues pertinent to human beings in their private and publi…
Students write assigned essays that are designed to augment interpretive, synthetic, rhetorical, and compositional skills.

This practice exercises and improves deductive and inductive reasoning skills and requires students to analyze choice as it affects the self and the other.
Students discuss application of knowledge of ethics (ancient and modern comparisons) to common lived experience in the 21st century.
This lived experience includes decisions made in personal life and public life (stressing in the latter category professional and business decisions).

What is Excellence?
